newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian Socialist leader presents new cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Albanian Socialist leader presents new cabinet.

text.p: Albania's Socialist Party chairman and prime minister-designate, Fatos Nano, presented his cabinet to the Balkan country's new president, Rexhep Mejdani, on Friday.
The new ministers went to the Palace of Brigades, the former villa of late King Zog on a hillside outside Tirana, to take the oath of office.
Mejdani, elected by the parliament on Thursday, has moved quickly to install a new administration. He met Nano on Thursday night to ask him to form a cabinet.
The interim finance minister, Arben Malaj, retains his post in the new lineup, while Bashkim Fino, who was interim prime minister, becomes deputy premier.

Paskal Milo, a history professor and deputy leader of the Social Democratic Party, the Socialists' main coalition allies, becomes foreign minister. Economy Minister Ylli Bufi, a Socialist, was prime minister of the 1991-2 national unity government.
The interior minister with a major role in restoring security to the lawless nation is Democratic Alliance leader Neritan Ceka, an archaeologist.
